title: Changing a Confirmed Room Reservation — Guest Services Guidance
content:
A confirmed Room Reservations reservation may be changed before arrival within the limits of its plan.

## The rule the desk applies

- **State.** A reservation is changed only while its status is confirmed.
- **What may change.** Dates may be changed only when the plan allows date changes, the room type only when the plan allows room-type changes, and the reservation may be moved to another guest profile only when the plan allows a transfer; an Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate reservation therefore stays exactly as booked.
- **Limits of the changed stay.** The changed stay must still meet the plan's length-of-stay and advance-booking limits and, for the Group Block Rate, fall inside the block dates and shoulder nights; a change that would break them can only be made by cancelling under the cancellation rules and booking again.
- **Re-pricing.** *No longer in force:* the former clause "re-pricing follows the rate-plan pricing standard" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis for the nightly rate of a changed reservation.
- **Removing nights after the deadline.** When the plan stops the removal of nights once the effective deadline has passed, nights cannot be removed once the effective cancellation deadline computed from the arrival date currently on the reservation has passed; the guest keeps the reservation as booked or cancels it as a late cancellation.
- **Online travel agency bookings.** Reservations booked through an online travel agency are changed only by that agency; the booking channel on the reservation record shows it.
- **Reward Night Rate.** A change to a Reward Night Rate reservation re-prices its points nights under the award chart, and the points difference is redeemed or redeposited by Ashbury Rewards.

## Points of judgement

| Request | Position |
|---|---|
| Change of room type on an Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate reservation | Not possible; the reservation stays exactly as booked |
| Transfer to another guest profile on a plan that does not allow a transfer | Not possible |
| Shortening a stay after its effective deadline has passed, on a plan that stops the removal of nights after the deadline | Nights cannot be removed; the reservation is kept as booked or cancelled as a late cancellation |
| A new date that would break the plan's advance-booking limit | Not made as a change; only cancelling and booking again |
| A change requested on a reservation already in house | Not possible; only confirmed reservations are changed |
